title: Base32 and coordinate pointer checks
question: Does the pinned G3 base32 and coordinate-pointer program flag any of three LP2 number streams beyond its shuffled controls?
reader_question: Do rune-derived number streams reveal an address?
summary: The source’s repeated-symbol pointer flag is reproducibly negative for all three streams. Its base32 match counts depend only on stream length, and its latitude/longitude regex cannot match a digit-only string.
finding: Longest low-entropy runs were 16, 10 and 16 against 200-shuffle maxima 22, 15 and 22. A planted 32-symbol run was detected. All 15 measurements and 3,000 source null calls reproduce, but this only tests a narrow repeated-symbol signal.
limitations: Every modulo-32 character is valid base32, making the 809 and 231 regex counts fixed by stream length, not address evidence. The digit concatenation supplies no period or separator for the lat/long regex. Coordinate-pair rate never triggers a flag. The source implementation omits additional framings mentioned in its preregistration. Plan timing is retrospective.
next_steps: A pointer claim should fix the character encoding and boundary rule, verify a valid planted address or coordinate survives the detector, and compare the identical search against a matched null.

scope.representation: Source 12,956-rune unsolved stream equals site LP2-00–49 and LP2-51–55 rune for rune; index-zero F retained.
scope.procedure: Map GP rune indices to prime value, one-based prime index or prime totient. Apply source modulo-32 base32 and decimal concatenation metrics, then compare 200 seed-3301+k histogram-preserving shuffles for every stream/metric. Replay original saved outputs and an independent low-entropy detector.
scope.parameters: 3 streams × 5 metrics × 200 source null calls = 3,000 source measurements, plus 15 real measurements and one planted low-entropy control.
scope.exclusions: No real onion address validation, alternate base32/byte grouping, punctuation insertion, other moduli, page resets, turtle paths or undeclared pointers.

review.kind: retrospective exact-source replay with independent detector and site parity
review.reviewer: Exact source output, independent 600 low-entropy control checks and source/site rune parity

reproduction.environment: Python 3 standard library; runs offline using bundled GP index stream and source result. Optional --check-site requires the site page JSON files.

visuals.caption: Observed repeated-symbol run is shorter than the maximum of 200 shuffled controls for all three mapped number streams.
